# Forage Canada

> A free guide to wild food in Canada: which wild plants are in season in each province and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 46 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/)

## Dishes

- [Labrador tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/labrador-tea/): A few leaves steeped weak, sweetened with a little maple syrup.
- [Maple water](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/maple-water/): Fresh maple sap drunk cold in sugaring season.
- [Sumac lemonade](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/sumac-lemonade/): Sumac clusters steeped in cold water, strained and sweetened.
- [Spruce tip syrup soda](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/spruce-tip-syrup-soda/): Spruce tip syrup with sparkling water.
- [Fiddleheads with butter](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/fiddleheads-with-butter/): Boiled fiddleheads sautéed in butter, the New Brunswick spring dish.
- [Pickled ramps](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/pickled-ramps/): Ramp bulbs in a spiced vinegar brine.
- [Partridgeberry jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/partridgeberry-jam/): Tart Newfoundland partridgeberries cooked with sugar.
- [Cranberry sauce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/cranberry-sauce/): Wild cranberries simmered with maple syrup.
- [Crab apple jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/crab-apple-jelly/): Crab apples simmered, strained and set.
- [Wild rice and mushroom pilaf](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/wild-rice-and-mushroom-pilaf/): Manoomin with mushrooms and herbs, from Ontario and Manitoba lakes.
- [Nettle soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/nettle-soup/): Nettle tops with potato and onion, blended.
- [Camas pit bake](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/camas-pit-bake/): Camas bulbs slow-cooked until sweet, after Coast Salish and Nlaka'pamux tradition.
- [Bannock with saskatoons](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/bannock-with-saskatoons/): Pan bread studded with saskatoon berries.
- [Wild blueberry muffins](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/wild-blueberry-muffins/): Muffins packed with small wild blueberries.
- [Saskatoon berry pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/saskatoon-berry-pie/): The Prairies' signature pie.
- [Blueberry grunt](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/blueberry-grunt/): Nova Scotian stewed blueberries topped with dumplings.
- [Bakeapple jam on toutons](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/bakeapple-jam-on-toutons/): Cloudberry jam on fried bread dough, Newfoundland style.
- [Maple taffy (tire d'érable)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/maple-taffy/): Hot maple syrup poured on snow and rolled onto a stick.
- [Pouding chômeur with maple](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/pouding-ch-meur-with-maple/): Quebec cake baked in maple syrup sauce.
- [Fireweed jelly tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/fireweed-jelly-tea/): Dried fireweed leaves brewed as tea, the Yukon way.
- [Pimbina jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/pimbina-jelly/): Highbush cranberry jelly, a Prairie and Manitoba favourite.
- [Chokecherry syrup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/chokecherry-syrup/): Prairie chokecherries cooked and strained into syrup for pancakes.
- [Chanterelle tourtière bites](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/chanterelle-tourti-re-bites/): Chanterelles in small Quebec-style pastry pies.
- [Porcini and wild rice stuffing](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/porcini-and-wild-rice-stuffing/): Wild rice with porcini, onion and herbs.
- [West Coast seaweed chowder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/west-coast-seaweed-chowder/): Seafood chowder with sliced bull kelp.
- [Huckleberry crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/huckleberry-crumble/): Mountain huckleberries under an oat crumble.
- [Soapberry whip (sxusem)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/soapberry-whip/): Soapberries whipped with water and a little sugar into a pink foam.
- [Chaga tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/chaga-tea/): Chaga simmered for hours into a dark, earthy tea.
- [Wild mint tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/wild-mint-tea/): Fresh wild mint steeped in hot water.
- [Balsam fir syrup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/balsam-fir-syrup/): Fir tips steeped in hot sugar syrup and strained.
- [Fried morels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/fried-morels/): Morels from last year's burns, fried in butter.
- [Oysters with mignonette](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/oysters-with-mignonette/): Island oysters shucked and served with shallot vinegar.
- [Pan-fried dulse](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/pan-fried-dulse/): Dried dulse crisped in a hot pan, a Maritime snack.
- [PEI mussels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/pei-mussels/): Mussels steamed with white wine, garlic and herbs.
- [Maritime clam chowder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/maritime-clam-chowder/): Clams, potato and cream, Nova Scotia style.
- [Morel cream sauce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/morel-cream-sauce/): Morels in a cream sauce over chicken or pasta.
- [Lion's mane steaks](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/lion-s-mane-steaks/): Thick slices pressed and seared in butter.
- [Prairie turnip stew](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/prairie-turnip-stew/): Prairie turnips simmered with bison.
- [Wild black currant jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/wild-black-currant-jam/): Wild currants cooked with sugar.
- [Buffaloberry jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/buffaloberry-jelly/): Frost-sweetened buffaloberries set into jelly.
- [Black cherry jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/black-cherry-jelly/): Black cherries cooked, strained and set.
- [Beach rose hip jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/beach-rose-hip-jelly/): Big rugosa hips cooked and strained into jelly.
- [Balsam fir shortbread](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/balsam-fir-shortbread/): Shortbread with ground fir tips.
- [Irish moss pudding](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/irish-moss-pudding/): Irish moss set in milk with vanilla, a PEI tradition.
- [Tarte aux framboises](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/tarte-aux-framboises/): Wild raspberries in a Quebec pastry tart.
- [Nannyberry fruit leather](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ca/dishes/nannyberry-fruit-leather/): Sieved nannyberry pulp dried into chewy leather.
